card.name: Spaces before starting dose amounts
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word just before a dose number or measurement, mainly in dosing instructions such as 'Initiate with', 'Give' or 'a' before a mg or mcg amount.

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: A bare space right before a numeric dose or time amount after a verb like initiate, give or recommended dosage is.

modes.label: Linking word before dose or lab term
modes.description: A short word such as 'with', 'a' or 'an' that leads into a drug, lab value or treatment phrase.

card.plain: It fires on the small gap or linking word right before a dose amount is given in dosing instructions.
